about: Built by tools/build_heritage.py from Heritage Museums & Gardens’ own 2026 visitor map, kept as the museum prints it (north is up and to the left). Paths, nature trails, stairs, gardens, lawns and parking are the map’s own shapes; the buildings are placed where the map draws them. The map is an illustrated plan, not to an exact scale; inside the galleries there is no published plan.
units: PDF points of the visitor map x 4 (about 0.3 m each)
